title: Provenance ledger mechanism decision
description: One line of provenance/mechanisms.jsonl — a decision about one harvested mechanism: adopted, adapted, rejected, already present, missing, or deferred. Source-free by construction (council O5): no source id, no pin, no locator. What links a source to a mechanism lives in the local ledger under the user-global runtime/lineage/ and never in the tracked tree. Append-only; a later row for the same mechanism_id supersedes an earlier one. Contract: provenance/README.md. Enforced by src/scripts/lint_harvest_provenance.ts.

mechanism_id.description: Kebab-case slug naming the mechanism. A harvest citation marker may cite it; for a mechanism seeded from harvests.jsonl it equals the harvest_id.

verdict.description: adopt|adapt — realised in this repo; reject — decided against; already — present before the harvest; gap — wanted and missing; deferred — wanted, parked.

realised_in.description: Repo-relative paths where the mechanism lives, each optionally suffixed ':<line>'. Required for adopt and adapt; every path must exist.

roadmap.description: Repo-relative path of the roadmap that owns a gap or deferred mechanism, or the literal 'open' when nothing owns it yet.

reopen_if.description: The condition under which a rejection or deferral is reconsidered.
